resources.os: Browser; Cloudflare or WebSocket-capable JavaScript server platform
resources.notes: No universal CPU/RAM/storage minimum published; size and concurrent rooms determine capacity. Hosted demo sync suitable only for prototyping.

selfHosting.notes: SDK operates single-user in browser with local persistence; multiplayer production requires your sync backend. Cloudflare template uses Durable Objects SQLite/R2; custom WebSocket JavaScript backend supported. Valid license needed for production.
